title: What’s this thing called Raindance?
use_cases: Join when you want to access member-only freebies and course discounts
Use when seeking evening or weekend vocational training in independent film
Configure when enrolling in formal Raindance Degree Programmes for acting and directing
Implement when setting up recurring annual membership fees
Use when facilitating charitable contributions for film education
content:
Hey! When I started Raindance in 1992, there was no internet, no emails and no websites. Now look!

Raindance has these different ways we can work with you:

1. Join Raindance! Your annual fees let us provide more cool things. You also get freebies and discounts on courses.
2. Our Evening and Weekend courses on writing, directing and producing independent film.
3. Our Raindance Degree Programmes in filmmaking, acting and directing.
4. You can Donate Here.
